title: 第8章 炉鼎第9章 小舅啊啊啊啊
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 楚安芷啃鸡的动作突然停住，她盯着赵归涯看了半晌，轻声道：“你倒是...想得开。”
此时的楚安芷脑子里已经过了十几个不可描述的故事。
“那师尊啊～请您把那些黄色废料甩掉，您的表情已经开始猥琐了。”
赵归涯：→_→（盯）
楚安芷立马坐直，表情十分正经：“哪儿有，你师尊我可是五好青年。”
赵归涯默默抿了一口茶：“炉鼎美人…”
“就该被炒！”
楚安芷说完就感受到对面深深寒光。
“嘿嘿，口误口误。”
“行了，没说什么，当时我妈知道我这个体质的时候，她对我的定义才叫离谱。”
“啥定义？”
楚安芷一个口快就问了，然后就接收到赵归涯幽怨的目光。
赵归涯无力扶额，有气无力的说：“海棠里的抹布受。”
这可真是亲妈，楚安芷都不知道怎么安慰了。
不过赵归涯倒是把自己给哄好了：“其实还好啦，虽说炉鼎这个特质真的很容易让人想入翩翩，但是但至少证明我天赋异禀不是？”
楚安芷差点被鸡肉噎到：“你这孩子怎么说话呢！”
赵归涯无辜：“我说的是修炼天赋，拥有炉鼎体质的人，可是最亲近天地万物的。
世间的万物之气都能收纳，只要好生利用，我们修炼是没有任何瓶颈期的，甚至不用经历雷劫就可以跨修为。
甚至我们刚出生的身体强度就已经达到体修的淬体境。”
楚安芷听得目瞪口呆，手里的鸡骨头掉在桌上：“这么逆天？！
难怪说...”
难怪说人人都想抓我们？赵归涯冷笑一声，指尖轻轻敲击着面具，“所以我才说，我妈给我取‘抹布受’这个外号也不算冤枉。
毕竟炉鼎的皮相也是很优越的，更别说我的千魅之体，可是又被称为药体圣体的。”
“你脾气可真是好，你重生回来竟然没直接把我像前世一样直接剁成不知名物体。
毕竟前世原身喝你血，还把你给酿酿酱酱了的。”
楚安芷震惊。
“我脾气确实好，不过前世的师尊不是我杀的。”
“对呀，那本书到底把我写成了个啥呀？
分明是我听说观世宗出事了，我过来看看，结果看到师尊一个人，我就吐槽了两句。
然后师尊想动用灵力杀我，结果自己炸了，害的我满身全都是人体组织的。”
楚安芷嘴巴张得能塞进整个叫花鸡：“等、等等...你说原身是自己炸的？！”
赵归涯优雅地擦了擦嘴角的蛋糕奶油：“对啊，我当时也很懵。”
content_en:
Chu Anzhi suddenly stopped chewing the chicken. She stared at Zhao Guiya for a long time and said softly: "You are... can think about it."
At this time, Chu Anzhi had already had more than a dozen indescribable stories in her mind.
"Then Master, please get rid of those yellow wastes. Your expression has begun to look obscene."
Zhao Guiya: →_→ (stare)
Chu Anzhi immediately sat up straight with a very serious expression: "No, your master and I are a good young man."
Zhao Guiya silently took a sip of tea: "The beauty of the furnace..."
"You should be fired!"
After Chu Anzhi said this, she felt a deep cold light on the other side.
"Hehe, slip of the tongue."
"Okay, I didn't say anything. When my mother knew about my physique, her definition of me was outrageous."
"What's the definition?"
Chu Anzhi asked quickly, and then received Zhao Guiya's resentful look.
Zhao Guiya couldn't help his forehead and said feebly: "The rag in Begonia is supported."
This is really her own mother. Chu Anzhi doesn't know how to comfort her.
However, Zhao Guiya coaxed himself: "Actually, it's okay. Although the characteristics of the furnace are really easy to imagine, but at least it proves that I am talented, right?"
Chu Anzhi almost choked on the chicken: "Why are you kid talking?"
Zhao Guiya innocently said: "I'm talking about cultivation talents and people with furnace physiques, who are the closest to all things in the world.
The energy of all things in the world can be absorbed. As long as we use it properly, there will be no bottleneck period in our cultivation. We can even reach a higher level of cultivation without going through a thunder tribulation.
Even the strength of our bodies when we are born has already reached the quenching state of physical cultivation. "
Chu Anzhi was stunned when she heard this, and the chicken bones in her hand fell on the table: "So outrageous?!
No wonder..."
Is it any wonder that everyone wants to arrest us? Zhao Guiya sneered and tapped the mask lightly with his fingertips, "That's why I say that it is not unfair for my mother to give me the nickname 'Rag Shou'.
After all, the appearance of the furnace cauldron is also very superior, not to mention my Thousand Charm Body, which is also known as the Holy Body of Medicine. "
"You have such a good temper. When you were reborn, you didn't just chop me into unknown objects like you did in your previous life.
After all, I drank your blood in my previous life and made you stuffed with sauce. "
Chu Anzhi was shocked.
"I do have a good temper, but I was not the one who killed the master in my previous life."
"Gah?"
"Yes, what did that book say about me?
Apparently I heard that something happened to Guanshizong, so I came over to take a look, but when I saw the master alone, I complained a few words.
Then Master wanted to use his spiritual power to kill me, but he blew himself up, causing me to be covered in human tissue. "
Chu Anzhi opened her mouth so wide that she could stuff the whole beggar's chicken in: "Wait, wait... you said that the original body was fried by yourself?!"
Zhao Guiya wiped the cake cream from the corner of his mouth gracefully: "Yes, I was confused at the time too."
